name: Oceanrider
summary: Oceanriders are underwater cavaliers who ride dolphins, orcas, or seahorses.
mechanicalNotes: Size-legal seahorse, orca, and dolphin selection, full-level mount progression, and the orca's early-Large exception are automated.

features.name: Armor Proficiency
features.summary: An oceanrider is proficient with light and medium armor, and with shields (but not tower shields) . This alters armor proficiency.

features.name: Aquatic Mount
features.summary: Choose an aquatic mount allowed by the oceanrider's size. It advances as a full-level Cavalier mount.

companionGrants.label: aquatic mount
rules: The aquatic mount advances using the oceanrider's full Cavalier level as its animal companion level.
Aquatic Mount replaces Expert Trainer and alters the normal Cavalier mount choices.
